thread:
olivia: Hey team, PR #3421 is red in the integration matrix — only failing on `db-migration-smoke` shard 2. Build/image looks fine in other shards. Can someone retrigger just that shard without rebuilding the docker image? @devops-anna ?

devops-anna: Yep, we can do a targeted rerun. Use the internal CI helper:`/ci rerun --pr 3421 --job integration/db-migration-smoke --shard 2 --preserve-image`

sam: Alternatively, if you prefer GH comments you can comment on the PR with:`/retest integration/db-migration-smoke shard=2`

olivia: Nice — thanks both. If the rerun still fails, should I ask for a rebuild-only? What's the command to refresh the image without retriggering the whole matrix?

devops-anna: For rebuild-only (refresh the image) run:`/ci rebuild-image --service integration --only-image` then requeue the shard if needed. But try the preserve-image rerun first — that'll skip the image push step.

ci-bot: Command acknowledged: queued rerun for PR 3421 job integration/db-migration-smoke shard=2 (preserve-image=true). Tracker: https://ci.internal/3421/run/98765 :rocket:

mike: FYI, if that shard was flaky we also have `--no-cache-kv` flag to clear kv caches: `/ci rerun --pr 3421 --job integration/db-migration-smoke --shard 2 --preserve-image --no-cache-kv`

olivia: Kicked the preserve-image rerun. Will report back.

ci-bot: Run 98765 started on runner-integ-07 (shard 2). Logs: https://ci.internal/3421/run/98765/logs

olivia: Success — shard 2 passed on rerun. Merging now. Thanks @devops-anna and everyone :tada:

devops-anna: Nice! If it flaps again we can add a canary to reroute traffic for a short window or enable flaky-test retry in the pipeline.

sam: Note for the docs: add example commands for `--preserve-image` and `--only-image` so folks don't rebuild images unnecessarily.

olivia: Will add a short blurb to the dev-infra runbook after lunch.
